summary: Iteration 177 frontend verification: 7/8 features fully pass, 1 partial. Verified sidebar order (desktop+mobile), 3 next-step navigations under video-guide player, missions section title link, tile poster images (12/12 use /api/guide/media/.../poster?v=), day-1 challenge briefing block with thumbnail+all-link → /video-guide, login teaser video poster attribute, and admin Guide Studio preview panel (6/6 multishot clips show guide-preview-<slug> + 'Als Vorschau rendern' button — no render clicks issued). Voice overlay renders correctly on /chat?voice=1 but the visible status text is the listening state ('Ich höre zu… · Tipp auf den Orb sendet sofort') rather than the specified idle text ('Tippe den Orb, um zu sprechen'), suggesting listening auto-starts.

ui_bugs.issue: Idle status text 'Tippe den Orb, um zu sprechen' is not observed; the overlay immediately shows the listening/silence-countdown state ('Ich höre zu… · Tipp auf den Orb sendet sofort'). Overlay itself renders correctly (voice-mode-overlay, voice-mode-orb, voice-mode-status, voice-mode-close, voice-mode-pause, voice-mode-mute all present). Playwright default Chromium may auto-grant/skip mic prompt in this environment, but the visible idle-state copy specified in the request is not reachable via UI in this run.

action_items: Verify VoiceMode initial/idle status text: when getUserMedia has not resolved (permission pending / denied), voice-mode-status should show 'Tippe den Orb, um zu sprechen' before any recording state is entered. Currently the listening-state copy is rendered immediately in an automated Chromium context.
critical_code_review_comments: Voice overlay: consider initializing status to the idle copy and only transitioning to 'Ich höre zu…' after the mic stream is actually ready and recording has started; otherwise headless/automated environments and users who deny mic access will not see the intended prompt.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (7/8 features pass; voice idle text is the only miss, overlay itself renders)

No render/apply/discard buttons were clicked. Voice overlay renders with all expected testids but idle text not observed — reported as minor UI issue.
rca of the issue: Voice overlay idle-text miss: The React state that controls voice-mode-status likely transitions to the 'listening' branch as soon as the overlay mounts (e.g., useEffect calling startRecording()/getUserMedia immediately), so the idle prompt 'Tippe den Orb, um zu sprechen' is either never rendered or replaced within a few ms. Fix: keep status='idle' until getUserMedia resolves AND the user taps the orb; only then swap to the listening copy. Reproduction: open /chat?voice=1 in a headless browser (or with mic blocked); expected idle text; observed listening text.
